react_result.final_narrative_text: Four independent pathway-enrichment paradigms converge on a single dominant biological signal: perturbation of tryptophan metabolism. RaMP-DB ORA returned KEGG:map00380 'Tryptophan metabolism' as its top hit with an FDR of 8.59e-19 and fold-enrichment of 875.7, covering seven of the twelve input metabolites (tryptamine, indoleacetaldehyde, 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid, serotonin, L-tryptophan, quinolinic acid, melatonin). MetaboAnalystR KSEA confirmed the same KEGG:hsa00380 pathway (p = 5.41e-09, 6 metabolites), and Mummichog's empirical-compound network assigned it the lowest p-value (0.00193) with an almost complete 16/17 compound overlap. WikiPathways variants WP:WP465 and WP:WP4210 (NAD+ biosynthesis from tryptophan) appeared in RaMP as secondary hits with FDR < 1e-10. The driver metabolites span three functional tiers of the pathway: the central substrate L-tryptophan (KEGG:C00078), key neuroactive intermediates serotonin (C00780) and melatonin (C01598), and the kynurenine-branch effectors 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid (C00632) and quinolinic acid (C03722). A secondary marginal signal in the Mummichog output links dihydrolipoate (C02147) to ascorbate/vitamin C and aldarate metabolism (p=0.054), suggesting mitochondrial redox involvement. The mycotoxin 2,3-epoxyaflatoxin B1 (C19586) and acetylcholine (C01996) did not reach pathway significance in any paradigm, indicating they are either peripheral contributors or biological noise. The tryptophan metabolism enrichment is consistent across ORA (hypergeometric), network-empirical (m/z), and multi-database consensus approaches, establishing it as the primary metabolic response to the treatment.

  "narrative_text": "A multi-paradigm metabolomics analysis of 12 differentially abundant metabolites identified tryptophan metabolism as the unanimous cross-paradigm winner. RaMP ORA returned 'Tryptophan metabolism' (KEGG:map00380) at rank 0 with FDR 8.59e-19, driven by 7 metabolites including L-tryptophan, tryptamine, indoleacetaldehyde, 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid, serotonin, quinolinic acid, and melatonin. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed the same pathway (hsa00380) at rank 0 with p=5.41e-09, overlapping 6 input metabolites. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently returned 'Tryptophan metabolism' (MUMM:tryptophan_metabolism) as its top hit (p=0.00176) with 16 of 17 pathway compounds matched to input, including the same core seven. Secondary pathway hits included the NAD+ biosynthetic branch (WP:WP3645, 'Tryptophan catabolism leading to NAD+ production'), the serotonin/melatonin biosynthesis module (REACT:R-HSA-209931), and the IDO metabolic pathway (WP:WP5414). Three metabolites mapped to distinct peripheral pathways: deoxyribose 1-phosphate to the Pentose phosphate pathway (MUMM:pentose_phosphate_pathway), N-formyl-L-glutamic acid to Vitamin B9 (folate) metabolism, and dihydrolipoate to Ascorbate and Aldarate Metabolism. The central biological narrative is a coordinated perturbation of the tryptophan degradosome: L-tryptophan is the canonical entry substrate, feeding parallel branch arms toward the neuroactive indoleamines (serotonin, melatonin) and the kynurenine-NAD+ axis (3-hydroxyanthranilic acid, quinolinic acid). The magnitude of enrichment (fold enrichment >800 in RaMP; overlap size 16/17 in mummichog) indicates that the treatment condition profoundly rewires tryptophan flux across all three major branch points. react_result.final_narrative_text: A multi-paradigm metabolomics analysis of 12 differentially abundant metabolites identified tryptophan metabolism as the unanimous cross-paradigm winner. RaMP ORA returned 'Tryptophan metabolism' (KEGG:map00380) at rank 0 with FDR 8.59e-19, driven by 7 metabolites including L-tryptophan, tryptamine, indoleacetaldehyde, 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid, serotonin, quinolinic acid, and melatonin. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed the same pathway (hsa00380) at rank 0 with p=5.41e-09, overlapping 6 input metabolites. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently returned 'Tryptophan metabolism' (MUMM:tryptophan_metabolism) as its top hit (p=0.00176) with 16 of 17 pathway compounds matched to input, including the same core seven. Secondary pathway hits included the NAD+ biosynthetic branch (WP:WP3645, 'Tryptophan catabolism leading to NAD+ production'), the serotonin/melatonin biosynthesis module (REACT:R-HSA-209931), and the IDO metabolic pathway (WP:WP5414). Three metabolites mapped to distinct peripheral pathways: deoxyribose 1-phosphate to the Pentose phosphate pathway (MUMM:pentose_phosphate_pathway), N-formyl-L-glutamic acid to Vitamin B9 (folate) metabolism, and dihydrolipoate to Ascorbate and Aldarate Metabolism. The central biological narrative is a coordinated perturbation of the tryptophan degradosome: L-tryptophan is the canonical entry substrate, feeding parallel branch arms toward the neuroactive indoleamines (serotonin, melatonin) and the kynurenine-NAD+ axis (3-hydroxyanthranilic acid, quinolinic acid). The magnitude of enrichment (fold enrichment >800 in RaMP; overlap size 16/17 in mummichog) indicates that the treatment condition profoundly rewires tryptophan flux across all three major branch points. A limitation is that 2,3-epoxyaflatoxin B1 was not annotated to any enriched pathway, and the FELLA random-walk step failed, preventing capture of indirect graph-diffusion hits.

RaMP ORA returned 'Tryptophan metabolism' (KEGG:map00380) at rank 0 with FDR 8.59e-19, driven by 7 metabolites including L-tryptophan, tryptamine, indoleacetaldehyde, 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid, serotonin, quinolinic acid, and melatonin. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed the same pathway (hsa00380) at rank 0 with p=5.41e-09, overlapping 6 input metabolites. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently returned 'Tryptophan metabolism' (MUMM:tryptophan_metabolism) as its top hit (p=0.00176) with 16 of 17 pathway compounds matched to input, including the same core seven. Secondary pathway hits included the NAD+ biosynthetic branch (WP:WP3645, 'Tryptophan catabolism leading to NAD+ production'), the serotonin/melatonin biosynthesis module (REACT:R-HSA-209931), and the IDO metabolic pathway (WP:WP5414). Three metabolites mapped to distinct peripheral pathways: deoxyribose 1-phosphate to the Pentose phosphate pathway (MUMM:pentose_phosphate_pathway), N-formyl-L-glutamic acid to Vitamin B9 (folate) metabolism, and dihydrolipoate to Ascorbate and Aldarate Metabolism. The central biological narrative is a coordinated perturbation of the tryptophan degradosome: L-tryptophan is the canonical entry substrate, feeding parallel branch arms toward the neuroactive indoleamines (serotonin, melatonin) and the kynurenine-NAD+ axis (3-hydroxyanthranilic acid, quinolinic acid). The magnitude of enrichment (fold enrichment >800 in RaMP; overlap size 16/17 in mummichog) indicates that the treatment condition profoundly rewires tryptophan flux across all three major branch points.
